meta.title: Microsoft Fake Sign-In Sites Catalog
meta.purpose: Defensive blocklist of LIVE URLs impersonating Microsoft sign-in pages (Microsoft 365, Outlook, Azure AD / Entra ID, Live) for blocking, detection engineering and threat hunting.
meta.warning: URLs are REAL and UNDEFANGED. Do not visit or submit credentials — consume them in blocklists and hunting queries only. Refreshed hourly; rolling retention window.

entries.technique: typosquat lookalike FQDN impersonating a Microsoft sign-in page (brand keywords + 'authentification' stuffed into a non-Microsoft host)
entries.detection: Alert on any non-microsoft.com host whose FQDN contains 'microsoft' together with 'auth'/'authentification'/'signin'; block *.sgn-1.com and flag /signin/login.html on unknown domains

entries.technique: credential-phish on a compromised legitimate domain that replays the genuine AADSTS50058 error string to mimic a real Azure AD silent-auth redirect
entries.detection: Hunt proxy/email/URL logs for external (non-login.microsoftonline.com) hosts carrying 'AADSTS50058' or 'error_description=login_required' query strings; these params should only ever appear on login.microsoftonline.com

entries.technique: typosquat credential-harvester abusing free Vercel hosting (brand name in *.vercel.app subdomain)
entries.detection: Alert on Microsoft/Entra sign-in pages served from *.vercel.app; hunt proxy/DNS logs for vercel.app hostnames containing 'microsoft'

entries.technique: typosquat domain ('notifcation' missing an 'i') hosting PHP credential-harvest kit with per-victim token path
entries.detection: Block parent domain microsoft-notifcation.com; hunt for GET/POST to /index.php?id=<long-hex> under microsoft-lookalike hosts and newly-registered 'microsoft-*notif*' domains

entries.technique: AiTM PhaaS ('EvilTokens'/ARTOKEN affiliate panel) hosted on Cloudflare Workers, OneDrive-themed doc lure
entries.detection: Alert on *.workers.dev hosts with 'onedrive'/'docviewer' labels + long random UUID-style subdomains proxying login.microsoftonline.com

entries.technique: AiTM credential/token harvester (Cloudflare Workers docviewer stage) in EvilTokens affiliate kit
entries.detection: Hunt DNS/proxy logs for the shared parent 'clear90489058903-document.workers.dev' and its docviewer subdomains

entries.technique: AiTM phishing C2/panel domain (pamconj.com) for EvilTokens Microsoft 365 credential theft
entries.detection: Block pamconj.com and subdomains (spx., dashboard-bl.); flag first-seen low-reputation domain resolving to 172.67.214.35

entries.technique: Typosquat ('0nline') credential-harvest page abusing Google App Engine (appspot.com) hosting
entries.detection: Alert on *.r.appspot.com hosts whose subdomain contains 'microsoft'/'login'/'0nline' serving index.php login forms

entries.technique: Outlook sign-in clone on Google App Engine, brand keywords stuffed into subdomain
entries.detection: Proxy rule: *.r.appspot.com with 'outlook'/'microsoft' in host label and static index.html login page

entries.technique: Office 365 sign-in phishing on App Engine (off365 typo lure)
entries.detection: Regex host match /(off?365|tlook|signin)/ on *.r.appspot.com

entries.technique: Free-hosting (wze.io) phishing with fake 'live.com/microsoftoffice365' path masquerade
entries.detection: Flag *.wze.io URLs containing 'live.com' or 'microsoftoffice365' path segments

entries.technique: Compromised legitimate site hosting voicemail-themed Office 365 credential page
entries.detection: Hunt for /voice/office/ or /office/index.php paths on unrelated (non-Microsoft) domains

entries.technique: Document-share lure ('newprojectdocument') on App Engine leading to Office 365 login clone
entries.detection: Block *.r.appspot.com hosts with document/onedrive lure labels serving /accessed*/index.html

entries.technique: OneDrive/LinkedIn document lure on App Engine, off365.html credential page
entries.detection: Alert on 'off365.html' filename and 'onedrive'/'linkedin' subdomain labels on appspot.com

entries.technique: App Engine auto-generated hostname serving off365.html credential-harvest page
entries.detection: Same-kit indicator: 'off365.html' on random *.r.appspot.com project hosts

entries.technique: Voicemail ('voicemail365') themed Office 365 phishing on Google App Engine
entries.detection: Flag 'voicemail'/'365' subdomain labels on *.r.appspot.com with login index.html

entries.technique: Fake 'Office 365 portal verification' page on App Engine
entries.detection: Host regex /office365.*(portal|verify|signin)/ on appspot.com

entries.technique: Free-TLD (.ga) random-string domain hosting 'Office-BG' login.php credential harvester
entries.detection: Block .ga/.tk/.ml domains with high-entropy hostnames and /Office*/login.php paths

entries.technique: typosquat credential-harvest domain ("microsoft-ssl" impersonation)
entries.detection: Alert on newly-registered domains containing 'microsoft' + 'ssl'/'secure' keywords in cert transparency logs

entries.technique: typosquat login page on free subdomain host (yzz.me)
entries.detection: Block/flag 'login-outlook365' and Outlook-brand strings on free dynamic-DNS/subdomain hosts

entries.technique: compromised legit site hosting obfuscated HTML credential page
entries.detection: Hunt for '*-obf.html' / '*-verify*.html' under unexpected paths (e.g. /quotesss/) on non-Microsoft domains

entries.technique: AiTM/MFA-relay lure on 'support'-themed lookalike domain
entries.detection: Flag '/microsoft365/mfa/' paths on domains impersonating support/helpdesk brands

entries.technique: compromised Brazilian law-firm site hosting fake 'microsoft-store' page
entries.detection: Hunt for 'microsoft-store.html' / Microsoft-brand HTML under /meetings/ on unrelated domains

entries.technique: abuse of Blogspot free hosting for brand-impersonation landing page
entries.detection: Flag *.blogspot.com subdomains containing 'microsoft'/'word'/'office' tokens

entries.technique: abuse of Vercel hosting for Microsoft-branded phishing app
entries.detection: Alert on *.vercel.app / *.workers.dev subdomains containing 'microsoft' + digits

entries.technique: typosquat credential-harvest landing page ('proteccion-outlook2026')
entries.detection: Alert on iceiy.com free-hosting subdomains containing 'outlook'/'office' with ?i= query param
